label: b2-sampling-20261123
question: On the B2 production tree, does a thinking temperature of 0.8 or 0.6 (top_p 0.95, top_k 20 kept) make decode at least 5% faster without a quality loss or more truncation/repetition?

facts.pi_models_json: openclaw/Qwen3.8-next thinking levels send temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20 (off: 0.7/0.8/20)
facts.precedence: request fields > config sampling block > card; gate17 and the replay send no sampling, so the config block sets theirs
facts.adoption_point: Pi models.json samplingParams.temperature (the server and production config stay as they are)

workload.requests: one per assistant message k: messages[:k]; 120 in all (A 71, B 49)
workload.body: model, messages, tools = pisim TOOLS, max_tokens 16384, stream false, seed 20261123 + request index (0-based)
workload.history: fixed: recorded messages, never the arm's own replies; replies are measured and discarded
workload.estimate_method: A prompts as recorded; B prompts = A last prompt + A last completion (61806) + B prompt - 506
limits: fixed history makes the engine re-read the recorded reply each step (hundreds to a few thousand tokens), Pi reuses its own
pisim system prompt about 800 tokens and 4 tools; no streaming, no NGINX; one session, no switching

smokes.reference: stored b2 arm, first 40 tasks: decode 135.3 tok/s, e2e 130.6 (same-day control smoke 1.5% off)

metrics.primary: replay requests with prompt >= 32K: engine decode tok/s (generated / gen_ms)
secondary: 40-task smoke decode tok/s and e2e tok/s
tok_win, accept, generated tokens, replay wall
metrics.loop_signs: finish=length replies; server notices of a repeated token / repeated thinking in server-stdout.txt

rules.env: C0c >=32K ms_win and decode tok/s within 3% of mean(C0a, C0b), else STOP_ENV
rules.aa: AA = (max - min) / mean of the three control decode tok/s; bar = max(5%, 2 x AA)
rules.pass: replay decode gain >= bar AND smoke decode tok/s > stored b2 AND smoke e2e > stored b2 AND replay loop signs (each) <= max over controls + 1 AND smoke finish=length <= 1, repeat notices <= 1, no errors
rules.validity: replay: the long-context checks plus the run config.json sampling block equal to the preregistered one (none for the control); smoke: the arm config.json sampling block equal
rules.choose: both pass: T08 unless T06 gains >= 3 points more on the replay; none: NO_GAIN

stage2.what: upgrade_gate.py probe b2-sampling-20261123 --sampling temperature=<chosen> without --limit (305 tasks, about 2 h)
stage2.pass: quality_gate NONINFERIORITY_ESTABLISHED (margin 5%, paired with stored b2 by task and seed) AND full-arm finish=length <= 3 AND repeat notices <= 3 (b2: 353 attempts all stop, 0 notices) AND full-arm decode tok/s (prodlog) >= b2 + 3%
stage2.then: recommend setting the thinking-level temperature in Pi models.json to the chosen value (off level unchanged), done by the user; observe real-traffic accept and tok_win with prodlog; revert to 1.0 on truncation or repetition
stage2.fail: NO_GAIN or QUALITY_RISK, recorded in the no-repeat ledger

limits: the task gate scores single tasks and cannot see repetition in long sessions; the replay only counts loop signs, it does not score quality
a lower temperature changes output length and style; replay wall and generated tokens are recorded, not judged

budget.stage1: about 2 h of production stop (3 replays x 13 min, 2 smokes x 37 min)

standing_rules: production config unchanged; no writes to the production tree or /home/hhtele/strata-0.1.43.1
